conventions.score: (W + T/2)/n of the first method; seed score s_k = mean over the cases of seed k
conventions.ci: 95% percentile interval, complete seed vectors resampled jointly
conventions.test: exact two-sided sign-flip randomization test of mean_k(s_k - 1/2), all 2^K patterns; H0: within a seed the two methods are exchangeable (label swap leaves the joint distribution of the seed's run pairs unchanged), seeds independent
conventions.check: Wilcoxon signed-rank of the K seed scores against 1/2 (zeros dropped)
